detailed_description:
The target video uses a modern realistic cinematic style with warm golden-hour backlight from a right-side window, shallow depth of field, wood-paneled school office, bookshelves and a black leather chair.
[Shot 1] A wide shot matches <Picture 4>. <Subject 3> turns sharply from beside <Subject 2> and strides toward the desk, his purple Qing robe sweeping. His deep, slow male voice, calm with quiet menace (S3), says over his shoulder: <d>[Chinese] 女儿 你跟他废什么话。</d> <Subject 1> sits upright behind the desk; <Subject 2> stands still at the right.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.800, the camera cuts to a medium shot: <Subject 3> reaches the desk, raises his hand and slaps <Subject 1> across the face. Her head snaps sideways, her eyes fly wide and she recoils in the chair.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.800, the camera cuts to a tight close-up of <Subject 3>, who looks down at the stunned teacher with an almost polite, mocking calm. His deep voice, even and cold (S3), says: <d>[Chinese] 老师你批评我吧。</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:08.800, the camera cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>, who holds a disbelieving, stunned stare, mouth half-open, processing the slap.
[Shot 5] At 00:10.800, the camera cuts closer to <Subject 1>, who finally finds her voice and protests, sharp and bewildered (S1): <d>[Chinese] 你打我干啥。</d>
[Shot 6] At 00:11.800, the camera cuts to a close-up of <Subject 3>, who smirks coldly, chin slightly raised, looking down. His deep voice, slow and icy (S3), says: <d>[Chinese] 找找自己的原因我为啥光打你不打别人。</d> The camera slowly pushes in toward his cold smirk.

overall_soundscape:
A low office hum continues. The swish of the Qing robe and a firm footstep on the wooden floor accompany the stride. A sharp slap cracks across the office at the desk, followed by the teacher's sharp gasp and papers rustling on the desk; a stunned beat of silence hangs before the protest.

non_diegetic_music:
A low, tense cello drone builds under the walk and the slap. On the father's mocking line "老师你批评我吧", the music drops to near-silence; after the teacher's protest and the father's final line, a single comedic trombone slide and a low bass-drum hit land, then cut abruptly to silence.
